theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M M' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → MeasurableSet M' → M ⊆ M' → M' ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M' ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M' x Q) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (E : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet E → ∃ (A : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R' : IMRep U n), R'.Represents A ∧ R'.carrier = R.carrier ∩ E ∧ R'.mult = R.mult ∧ R'.orient = R.orient) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (N k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1)) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsCompact X.support → X.mass < ∞ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) (k + 1 + 1), ∃ η : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) (k + 1), (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid N), (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) (k + 1)) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1 + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) ∧ C ω = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, X (η t)) → IsIntegerMultiplicity C
